title: Lift the core test-line budget by CEO decision
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-16, on the report that core's test budget stood at 128,995 of 129,000 lines: "lift the core test budget". Raise TEST_RUST_CEILING so tests and guards can be added again, record the decision in docs/lean-core.md and beside the constant, and move no other ceiling.

reuse.searched: tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs (the category budgets and how they are measured) and the ceiling history in docs/lean-core.md, including the earlier CEO-decided raise of this budget (T-CLAUDE-411, 127,000 -> 129,000). The existing constant and decision log are changed in place; nothing new is built.

limitations: One ceiling constant and its record; no test or runtime behaviour changes. Main is unqualified development, not a release.

TEST_RUST_CEILING rises 129,000 -> 139,000 (128,999 measured). The CEO gave no figure; 10,000 is about what tests grew since the budget was set on 2026-11-15 (118,857 measured). The last raise of this budget was 2,000 lines and was used up in a day.
No other ceiling moves: runtime, tooling, vendor, pillar src and per-file ceilings are unchanged (tests/architecture_tests.rs is at 3,339 of its 3,500 lines).

The Susi Board could be read but not written from this cloud session (HTTP 403 on refs/board/* and refs/claims/*); no Claim or Landed item was posted and the record is closed by hand (Mandate 76 section 7).
